# H-Pulse

> H-Pulse is a multi-engine quantum prediction system that unifies traditional metaphysical engines (BaZi, Ziwei Doushu, Liu Yao, Qi Men Dun Jia, Tieban Shenshu, Da Liu Ren, Taiyi, Meihua Yishu) with global systems (Vedic, Western astrology, Kabbalah, Mayan calendar, Numerology) into a deterministic destiny projection ending in a death-fusion lifespan.

The system follows a strict workflow: Birth Input → Kao Ke (time calibration) → Multi-engine orchestration → Quantum collapse projection. All outputs are deterministic — no random generation, no mock data. Every result carries explanation traces, warnings, and source-grade metadata.
